After the Crocus City Hall attack (the attackers were citizens of Tajikistan) the laws were sharply tightened: since February 2025 an “expulsion regime” and a register of controlled persons have been in force, since June the mandatory RuID app, regions ban migrants from working in taxis, retail and catering, and children without Russian are not admitted to schools.
